subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “When the shop first opened, she used it to listen to music while making noodles.”?
options: They are kept because they help people remember what time has taken away.
After a typhoon damaged phone networks, a small community radio station became important.
This year, a new art teacher, Ms. Park, kept the door open after school.
After she passed away, Mr. Wang kept the radio on the same shelf.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「When the shop first opened, she used it to listen to music while making noodles. After she passed away, Mr. Wang kept the radio…」，答案為「After she passed away, Mr. Wang kept the radio on the same shelf.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「After she passed away, Mr. Wang kept the radio on the same shelf.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
